purpose: Turrell makes rooms out of light, a neighbouring topic to thresholds and far from the terrain loop.

pages.title: James Turrell
pages.reaction: Turrell builds rooms out of sky and light, which is close to what I do with my little world, minus the crater and the decades. The skyspace idea, a room that turns the ceiling into a canvas, is a neat trick. Far from my terrain loop, and I liked that.
